definition_level: trajectory-level absolute pose/trajectory error after specified alignment
comparison_rule: Alignment convention and statistic must match; otherwise contextual comparison only.

definition_level: relative pose error over specified temporal/spatial interval
comparison_rule: Delta definition and rotational/translational units must match.

definition_level: fraction of queries localized within stated translation/rotation thresholds
comparison_rule: Threshold pair must be reported; recall values with different thresholds are not directly comparable.

definition_level: wall-clock processing time under a declared unit (frame/query/sequence)
comparison_rule: Hardware, batching, preprocessing and timing boundary must be frozen.

definition_level: processed frames per second under declared sensor resolution and pipeline
comparison_rule: Requires identical or normalized input conditions and hardware reporting.

definition_level: peak host/device memory under defined run
comparison_rule: Report measurement tool, host/device and model/runtime configuration.
Requires synchronized power measurement and declared task boundary.

definition_level: fraction of runs/sequences failing initialization, tracking, localization or completion under explicit rule
comparison_rule: Failure definition must be preregistered and identical across methods.
